sentences.en: A loophole in the law allowed him to escape prosecution.
sentences.zh: 法律中的一个漏洞使他得以逃避起诉。

sentences.en: His diplomatic passport entitles him to immunity from criminal prosecution.
sentences.zh: 他的外交护照赋予了他免受刑事起诉的权利。

sentences.en: The prosecution condemned the defendant for kidnapping a child.
sentences.zh: 检方因绑架儿童而对被告进行了谴责。
